summary: The Wwise listener of a sound camera, written by ecl::sound::CameraSystem::UpdateListenerPosition / UpdateSoundForCameras together with ls::SoundManager::SetListenerTransformation; read by room, ambience mix, mix state, performance, spell impact and occlusion systems.

fields.name: Front
fields.evidence: ecl::sound::CameraSystem::UpdateListenerPosition (EoCClient.dll+0xDD20E0) copies the 24-byte ls::SoundObjectOrientation to +0..+0x17; in UpdateSoundForCameras the orientation is built from TransformComponent::GetDirVector (first) and GetUpVector (second). Live: unit vectors.

fields.name: Up
fields.evidence: Second half of SoundObjectOrientation (GetUpVector), see Front.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: UpdateListenerPosition: puVar2[3] / +0x20 = the Vector3f position argument (also given to SetListenerTransformation); ecl::sound::RoomSystem (bg3.exe+0x1DB0C60) reads +0x18/+0x20 with a 0x2C stride to find the listener's room. Live: world coordinates (52.31, 1.224, 204.2).

fields.name: ZoomLevel
fields.evidence: UpdateListenerPosition: +0x24 = float argument; UpdateSoundForCameras passes the value from helpers::GetCameraZoomLevel (via UpdateCameraSoundInfo). Live: 0, 0.7647, 1.

fields.name: PlayerIndex
fields.evidence: UpdateListenerPosition: byte +0x28 = (char) ls::EInputPlayerIndex argument (PlayerManager::GetInputPlayerIndex). Live: 0 or 0xFF.

fields.name: field_29
fields.evidence: UpdateListenerPosition: byte +0x29 = bool argument; UpdateSoundForCameras sets it to 1 only on the branch that positions the listener from helpers::GetSoundListenerPosition / GetAmbientVolumeCheckPoint (0 otherwise); bg3.exe+0x1DB0C60 (RoomSystem) only assigns a SoundRoomListenerComponent when it is set. Live: 0/1.

open_questions: Exact meaning of the bool at +0x29 (listener positioned from the gameplay listener point?).
